self_caught_and_corrected_this_session_n: Attempted a tight PVR=(PAP-LAP)/Q single-resistor reconstruction from Teitel 1990's stated numbers (PAP unchanged, LAP doubled, Q->401%, PVR->34%); solving for the implied baseline LAP/PAP ratio gives approximately -0.57 -- physically impossible (negative ratio of two positive gauge pressures). honest_gaps: No live-verified absolute baseline fetal %CVO-to-lung number was found this session -- Rudolph 1985's own primary paper (the classical source for exact %CVO tables) has no abstract accessible live (pre-abstracting era); the current-divider derivation (Sec.5) is therefore shape-only (monotonic, convex, swept over an un-fit k), not a calibrated absolute baseline fraction. The single largest quantitative gap in this document.

Species mismatch for most of the birth-transition hard numbers: PVR%, PBF-fold-change, and DA-resistance-fold-change are sheep data (Teitel/Crossley/Heymann-Rudolph); cross-checked for DIRECTION in humans (Rasanen 1998), not shown to transfer 1:1 in exact magnitude. Kiserud & Acharya (2004) directly state the human fetus shunts LESS via DV/FO and directs MORE via lungs than the fetal sheep.

Sun 2015 Table 3's subgroup-to-number pairing beyond the two textually-named facts (SV=lowest AAo SaO2; TOF=only subgroup not significantly different from control) was not independently reconstructed from the crude text-extraction used this session -- G6 deliberately uses only the directly-quoted facts, not an inferred full ranking of all 5 CHD subgroups.

Crossley 2009's 172 mL/min DA-flow value (5-min-post-ventilation) is presented as a magnitude in a falling sequence; whether it is still net right-to-left or already includes a reversed component at that exact timepoint is not fully resolved from the abstract alone (reverse flow is stated to reach 'up to 50% of total PBF at 30 min', implying reversal may be a slightly later event than 5 minutes).

Lang 2016's spatial-dissociation finding (PBF increase not restricted to aerated lung regions, unrelated to oxygenation in unventilated regions) is a genuine unresolved complication to this document's two-mechanism (ventilation vs O2) framing -- some component of the birth-related PBF increase is non-local/reflex, not shown to be the complete mechanistic account.

Darby 2020 shows the shunt network is compensating/self-regulating (raising DV shunt fraction did NOT raise cerebral O2 delivery, because foramen-ovale flow fell reciprocally) -- a real complication for any simple 'more shunt = more brain O2' reading.

The crista dividens / Eustachian-valve anatomical routing detail (used qualitatively in Sec.3's topology narrative) was not itself independently re-verified live this session -- the FUNCTIONAL streaming claim it is invoked to explain IS independently verified (Rudolph 1983, Sun 2015).

Sec.1's master argument's falsifying condition (a source reporting fetal pulmonary-venous O2 content exceeding umbilical-venous O2 content) was not exhaustively searched for -- absence of a found counter-source this session is not proof of absence in the wider literature.
